subject: Coord: consolidate governance + platform stakeholders for Redwood demo
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@bluepeak.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood platform demo — proposed 4/27 10:00am PT

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick follow-up. We'd like to lock a first demo of Redwood for our cloud engineering and machine learning teams — proposed slot is Tue 4/27 at 10:00am PT for ~45 minutes.

Attendees on our side: Emily Park (EM), Rajesh Menon (VP Security - tentative), and our procurement lead (procurement@bluepeak.com).

Goals: 1) high-level architecture and multi-region routing, 2) cost/throughput profile for ~2k RPS baseline, 3) Q&A on security/compliance.

Attached is a short intake doc (bluepeak-intake.pdf) with our current constraints. Let me know if that time works or if you prefer alternatives.

Thanks,
Emily

Attachment: bluepeak-intake.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood platform demo — proposed 4/27 10:00am PT

Emily — really appreciate the intake. Quick heads up: we need to include a few additional reviewers on our side for a proper run-through:

- Kimberly Park (Security)
- Sean Gallagher (Platform)
- Vivek Kulkarni (Infra)
- Marissa Cole (Procurement)

Sean has travel the week of 4/26–4/30, so the 4/27 slot will be hard for him and for the platform deep-dive to be useful. Given the added stakeholders and the likely length of the session, can we move to one of these alternatives where Sean + Kimberly can join?

Option A: Mon, 5/03 — 1:00pm PT (75 minutes)
Option B: Tue, 5/04 — 3:00pm PT (90 minutes)

If either of those works, we'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short pre-read bundle (SOC2 summary, network diagram) in advance. Also — if Rajesh (CISO) will attend, any specific artifacts he wants up front (e.g., encryption/key management, retention policies)?

FWIW, procurement (Marissa cc'd) would like 15 minutes at the end for billing/contract scope.

Thanks,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
From: Emily Park <emily.park@bluepeak.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood platform demo — proposed 4/27 10:00am PT

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the heads up and the attendee list. Rajesh (CISO) just confirmed he can join and asked for encryption and key rotation notes ahead of time. Our procurement lead (procurement@bluepeak.com) will also be on the call.

Option B (Tue 5/04 at 3:00pm PT) works better for our schedules. Please send the calendar invite and pre-reads when ready.

Attendees confirmed from BluePeak:
- Emily Park (EM)
- Rajesh Menon (CISO)
- Procurement: procurement@bluepeak.com

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (ICS)

Emily
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood platform demo — proposed 4/27 10:00am PT

On Mon, Apr 19, 2027 at 10:01 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Sofia — really appreciate the intake. Quick heads up: we need to include a few additional reviewers on our side for a proper run-through: ...

Thanks — confirming engineering asks from our side: when we run the demo please include a 20–25 minute platform deep-dive covering: routing rules, fallback policies, and an example trace showing latency under 95th pct load. That will help our infra team validate performance claims.

Also, given CISO + security attendance, can we extend to 90 minutes and structure the agenda: 1) 20m overview, 2) 25m platform deep-dive, 3) 20m security/compliance Q&A, 4) 15m procurement/next-steps?

Kimberly — if you want any specific evidence up front (SOC2 sections, encryption key lifecycle), call that out and we can assemble a secure share.

—Vivek

Team — confirmed for Tue, May 4 at 3:00pm PT (90 minutes). Zoom link and calendar invite below. Agenda as discussed:

1) 15m — Product overview and model catalog + routing patterns
2) 30m — Platform deep-dive (routing, caching, KV cache management, latency traces)
3) 25m — Security/compliance Q&A (SOC2, KMS integration, retention)
4) 15m — Procurement and next steps (PO cadence, billing contacts)

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-bluepeak-5-04
Pre-reads (attached): SOC2-summary.pdf, network-diagram.png — I'll place a secure folder on the Redwoods share and send the link to Rajesh.

Attendees (final):
- BluePeak: Emily Park; Rajesh Menon (CISO); procurement@bluepeak.com
- Redwood: Sofia Ivanova; Marissa Cole; Vivek Kulkarni; Kimberly Park; Sean Gallagher

Please confirm any additional asks by EOD Monday so we can assemble pre-reads and test the demo notebook. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sofia
